info.title: AgentToll
info.description: Pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents. Paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with an x402 quote; pay $0.001-$0.008 in USDC on Base mainnet per call. No API keys. Onchain identity: agenttoll.base.eth.

get.summary: Service status (free)
Machine-readable catalog of everything for sale (free)
Sample response shapes for every paid endpoint (free)
Onchain-derived toll counter (free): calls, USDC revenue, unique payers, and the same figures excluding the operator's own test wallet

200.description: Stats read from USDC transfers on Base

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker (eth, btc, sol, usdc, aero, degen...) or any CoinGecko id, e.g. degen-base

400.description: Invalid path or query parameter (not charged)

get.summary: Base gas price check: gas price and latest block, optionally costed for a transaction size

parameters.name: gasLimit
parameters.description: Optional. Price a transaction of this gas size: the reply gains estimate.ethCost and estimate.usdCost. 21000 is a plain transfer, ~65000 an ERC-20 transfer, 150000-300000 a swap.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Return only the top N tokens. Defaults to the provider's full list.

get.summary: New token radar on Base with a liquidity floor: fresh pools that already hold real liquidity, spam filtered

parameters.name: minLiquidity
parameters.description: Optional. Liquidity floor in USD. Raise it to cut more spam, lower it to see everything new.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. How many pools to return, busiest first.

get.summary: Crypto market sentiment check: Fear & Greed index with yesterday comparison and optional daily history

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Optional. Add a daily history array covering this many days, so you can see whether sentiment is turning.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Optional. Comma-separated tickers or CoinGecko ids to price instead of the default majors, up to 6. Same flat price either way.

get.summary: Turkish lira crypto premium check: implied vs official USD/TRY via a crypto cross-rate

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Optional. Which asset carries the cross-rate. USDT is the reading desks quote, because it is what actually changes hands.

get.summary: Turkish exchange spread check: BTCTurk and Paribu TRY quotes converted to USD vs the global price

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Optional. Which pair to check, default btc.

get.summary: Wallet portfolio on Base: everything an address holds valued in USD, ETH plus its ERC-20 tokens, largest first

parameters.name: minValue
parameters.description: Optional. USD floor per holding, which is what keeps airdropped spam out of the answer.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. How many holdings to list. The total always covers everything above the floor, listed or not.

200.description: Holdings, totals, and how many were hidden or could not be priced

400.description: Invalid path or query parameter (not charged)

get.summary: Token safety check for a Base token - honeypot, rug and trap detection: simulated buy and sell, taxes, owner privileges, holder concentration, liquidity, deployer history

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token contract address on Base

200.description: Verdict (clear, caution, high-risk or insufficient-data) plus every individual check

example.name: Aerodrome

checks.detail: A simulated buy and sell both succeeded
Owner can: owner can mint new supply
The deployer is a wallet with 731 transactions and holds 0.12094 ETH

example.disclaimer: Automated checks against public data, not investment advice. Passing every check does not make a token safe.

example.methodology: Each token judged from its first appearance: verdict and price then, deepest-pool price now. Snapshots are dated git commits.
example.disclaimer: A track record, not investment advice.
